1.title: Cleanup of Rotting Food at L.A. Warehouse Took Too Long, Residents Say
1.summary: The stench has enveloped a neighborhood next to a food warehouse that burned in a June fire, prompting legislative action, lawsuits and thousands of complaints.

2.title: 'A giant leap forward': Nasa launches powerful new space telescope to explore mysteries of the Universe
2.summary: The US space agency's telescope is starting a multi-year mission to create a new map of the universe and learn more about dark energy and dark matter.

3.title: More Than 22,000 Ancient Artifacts Seized in Florida
3.summary: The items include Egyptian statues and ancient Greek and Roman coins that date back 1,000 to 5,000 years, officials said.

4.title: Iceland Votes to Steer Clear of European Union Talks
4.summary: After divisive debate, Icelanders rejected a proposal to resume negotiations on joining the bloc in a referendum with the highest voter turnout in almost two decades.

6.title: Eight killed and others missing after ferry capsizes off northern Cyprus
6.summary: A search and rescue operation is under way after a ferry carrying nearly 270 people turns over after leaving port.
